label: Alpine KPI Card
description: Alpine KPI / stat card — friendly mobile-marketing card: muted label, count-up value, soft delta pill (arrow + change), sublabel, optional sparkline. Every line is editable on the canvas, and the card composes at any size.

label.label: Label
label.description: The metric's name, set small above the value (e.g. "Monthly Revenue").

value.label: Value
value.description: The headline number, exactly as it should read (e.g. "$48.2K", "86%"); digits count up on the intro.

delta.label: Delta
delta.description: The signed change shown in the pill (e.g. "+12.5%"). Empty hides the pill.

sublabel.label: Sublabel
sublabel.description: Muted caption beside the change (e.g. "vs last month"). Empty hides it.

title.label: Title
title.description: Optional card title above the KPI; setting one adds a header.

subtitle.label: Subtitle
subtitle.description: Optional line under the title, in the card header.

direction.label: Direction
direction.description: Which way the change went — the arrow and its colour (green up / red down / muted flat).

valueColor.label: Value Color
valueColor.description: Colour of the headline number; empty uses the theme's title colour.

sparkline.label: Sparkline
sparkline.description: Optional trend series drawn as a soft sparkline along the card bottom; leave it unset for a trend that follows the direction.

anim.renderMode.label: Render mode
anim.renderMode.description: "premium" (default): soft alpha fades of the pill / sublabel / sparkline — a per-pixel geq each. "light": the same via free enable-gate pops — no geq, composable, cheap when nested.

anim.reduceMotion.label: Reduce motion
anim.reduceMotion.description: Skip motion; render the final static card.

anim.introFrac.label: Intro length
anim.introFrac.description: Share of the clip the intro fills (the rest holds).

anim.countUp.label: Count up
anim.countUp.description: Count the value up on intro.

theme.label: Theme
theme.description: Opt into a theme source. Uses the alpine preset by default; set a producer slug + namespace to pull shared design tokens. Explicit color props still win.

theme.slug.label: Producer slug
theme.slug.description: Producer template to seed tokens from (e.g. "@m0saic/theming/v1").

theme.namespace.label: Namespace
theme.namespace.description: Upstream alias to read tokens from. Default "theme".

theme.forceFetch.label: Force fetch
theme.forceFetch.description: Re-seed via the slug even if the namespace is populated.

debugLayout.label: Debug layout
debugLayout.description: Dev-only layout contract view: renders the contract wireframe instead of the card — the delta pill GREEN at its intended aspect, RED when stretched. Deterministic false default; production never sets it.
